tools.name: create_asset
tools.title: Create Asset
tools.description: Create a new game resource asset - a prefab, sound event or any other GameResource type. Give starting json to fill it, or leave empty for a default. Fails if the asset already exists - asset_write edits existing ones.

type.description: Asset type file extension, e.g. 'prefab' or 'sndevt'. See asset_types.

path.description: Where to create it, relative to the project's assets folder, e.g. 'weapons/pistol.prefab'.

json.description: Starting json document. Empty creates a default resource.
